verses.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1:6: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshishah, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:10: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a mighty man upon the earth.
verses.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.1:28: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.1:29: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.1:32: And the sons of Keturah, the concubine of Abraham: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.1:34: And Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.1:38: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.1:39: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and the sister of Lotan was Timna.
verses.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.1:41: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishon: Uz and Aran.
verses.1:43: And these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the sons of Israel: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.1:44: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah, from Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.1:45: And Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.1:46: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck down Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.1:47: And Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.1:48: And Samlah died, and Shaul from Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
verses.1:49: And Shaul died, and Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.1:50: And Baal-Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai, and the name of his wife was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.1:51: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,
verses.1:52: Chief Oholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
verses.1:53: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
verses.1:54: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
verses.2:1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;
verses.2:2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.2:3: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah; three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite woman. Now Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD, and He put him to death.
verses.2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore to him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.2:5: The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.2:6: And the sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.
verses.2:7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who acted unfaithfully concerning the devoted things.
verses.2:8: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.2:9: And the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.2:10: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah.
verses.2:11: Nahshon fathered Salma, and Salma fathered Boaz.
verses.2:12: Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse.
verses.2:13: Jesse fathered Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,
verses.2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.2:15: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh.
verses.2:16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel—three.
verses.2:17: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.2:18: Now Caleb the son of Hezron fathered children by Azubah his wife and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.2:19: When Azubah died, Caleb took Ephrath for himself, and she bore him Hur.
verses.2:20: And Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.2:21: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
verses.2:22: And Segub fathered Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.2:23: But Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, with Kenath and its villages, sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.2:24: After the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, Hezron's wife Abijah bore him Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
verses.2:25: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.2:26: Jerahmeel also had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.2:27: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.2:28: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.2:29: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.2:30: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; and Seled died without sons.
verses.2:31: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.2:32: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai, were Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without sons.
verses.2:33: And the sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.2:34: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.
verses.2:35: So Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as a wife, and she bore him Attai.
verses.2:36: Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad.
verses.2:37: Zabad fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed.
verses.2:38: Obed fathered Jehu, and Jehu fathered Azariah.
verses.2:39: Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah.
verses.2:40: Eleasah fathered Sismai, and Sismai fathered Shallum.
verses.2:41: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.2:42: Now the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.2:43: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.2:44: Shema fathered Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem fathered Shammai.
verses.2:45: And the son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.2:46: Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran fathered Gazez.
verses.2:47: And the sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.2:48: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.2:49: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,
verses.2:51: Salma, the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.
verses.2:52: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, and half of the Menuhoth.
verses.2:53: And the families of Kiriath-jearim were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.2:54: The sons of Salma were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.2:55: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.3:1: Now these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelitess;
verses.3:2: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
verses.3:4: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months; and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.
verses.3:5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four by Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.3:9: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.3:10: Now Solomon's son was Rehoboam; Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.3:11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.3:14: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.3:15: And the sons of Josiah were Johanan the firstborn, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.
verses.3:16: And the sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.
verses.3:17: And the sons of Jeconiah the captive were Shealtiel his son,
verses.3:18: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel were Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.3:20: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed—five.
verses.3:21: And the sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.3:22: And the sons of Shecaniah were Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three.
verses.3:24: And the sons of Elioenai were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven.
verses.4:1: The sons of Judah were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.4:2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
verses.4:3: And these were from the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.4:4: And Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.4:5: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.4:6: And Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.4:7: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, and Ethnan.
verses.4:8: And Koz fathered Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.4:9: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I bore him in pain."
verses.4:10: And Jabez called upon the God of Israel, saying, "Oh, that You would surely bless me and enlarge my border, and that Your hand would be with me, and that You would keep me from harm, so that it may not bring me pain!" And God brought about what he had asked.
verses.4:11: Now Chelub the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
verses.4:12: And Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
verses.4:13: And the sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel were Hathath.
verses.4:14: And Meonothai fathered Ophrah; and Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of the Valley of Craftsmen, for they were craftsmen.
verses.4:15: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh were Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah: even Kenaz.
verses.4:16: And the sons of Jehallelel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.4:17: And the sons of Ezrah were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And she conceived Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.4:18: And his Judean wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these were the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
verses.4:19: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.4:20: And the sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
verses.4:21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea;
verses.4:22: and Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. Now these records are ancient.
verses.4:23: These were the potters and those who dwelt at Netaim and Gederah; there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.4:24: The sons of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul;
verses.4:25: Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.
verses.4:26: And the sons of Mishma were Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, and Shimei his son.
verses.4:27: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren did not have many children, nor did all their family multiply like the children of Judah.
verses.4:28: They dwelt at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
verses.4:29: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,
verses.4:30: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,
verses.4:31: at Beth-marcaboth, at Hazar-susim, at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
verses.4:32: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five cities—
verses.4:33: along with all their villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their dwelling places, and they had their genealogical record.
verses.4:34: Also Meshobab, Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.4:35: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.4:36: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.4:37: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
verses.4:38: these mentioned by name were leaders in their families, and their fathers' houses increased greatly.
verses.4:39: So they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.4:40: And they found rich and good pasture, and the land was broad, quiet, and peaceful; for some of the descendants of Ham had dwelt there formerly.
verses.4:41: And these who were recorded by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and they struck down their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and utterly destroyed them to this day. Then they dwelt in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.4:42: And some of them, five hundred men of the sons of Simeon, went to Mount Seir, with Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.
verses.4:43: And they struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped, and they have dwelt there to this day.
verses.5:1: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel—for he was the firstborn, yet because he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, though he was not to be enrolled in the genealogy according to the birthright.
verses.5:2: For Judah prevailed over his brethren, and from him came a ruler, yet the birthright belonged to Joseph.
verses.5:3: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.5:4: The sons of Joel were Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.5:5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.5:6: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria carried into exile; he was a prince of the Reubenites.
verses.5:7: And his brethren by his families, when the genealogy of their generations was enrolled, were Jeiel the chief, and Zechariah,
verses.5:8: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. He dwelt in Aroer, even as far as Nebo and Baal Meon.
verses.5:9: Eastward also he dwelt as far as the entrance of the wilderness extending from the River Euphrates, because their livestock had multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.5:10: Now in the days of Saul they waged war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the territory east of Gilead.
verses.5:11: And the sons of Gad dwelt opposite them in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:
verses.5:12: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.5:13: And their brethren, according to their fathers' houses, were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
verses.5:14: These were the sons of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
verses.5:15: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was chief of their fathers' house.
verses.5:16: And they dwelt in Gilead, in Bashan and its villages, and in all the pasturelands of Sharon to their farthest borders.
verses.5:17: All of these were enrolled by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.5:18: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had valiant men—men who bore shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained in warfare—forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty able to go out to war.
verses.5:19: They made war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.5:20: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites and all who were with them were delivered into their hand; for they cried out to God in the battle, and He answered their prayer, because they put their trust in Him.
verses.5:21: So they carried away their livestock—fifty thousand of their camels, two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand donkeys—and also one hundred thousand souls.
verses.5:22: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
verses.5:23: Now the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land; from Bashan as far as Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon, they multiplied.
verses.5:24: And these were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, men of renown, heads of their fathers' houses.
verses.5:25: Yet they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
verses.5:26: Therefore the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria and the spirit of Tilgath-Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, to this day.
verses.5:27: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.5:28: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.5:29: And the children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.5:30: Eleazar fathered Phinehas, and Phinehas fathered Abishua.
verses.5:31: Abishua fathered Bukki, and Bukki fathered Uzzi.
verses.5:32: Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, and Zerahiah fathered Meraioth.
verses.5:33: Meraioth fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub.
verses.5:34: Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz.
verses.5:35: Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, and Azariah fathered Johanan.
verses.5:36: And Johanan fathered Azariah—it was he who ministered as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.5:37: And Azariah fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub.
verses.5:38: Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Shallum.
verses.5:39: Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah.
verses.5:40: Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
verses.5:41: And Jehozadak went into exile when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.6:1: The sons of Levi were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.6:2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.6:3: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.6:4: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.6:5: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.6:6: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
verses.6:7: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.6:8: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
verses.6:9: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.6:10: And the sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.6:11: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
verses.6:12: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
verses.6:13: And the sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vashni, and Abijah.
verses.6:14: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
verses.6:16: And these are those whom David appointed over the ministry of song in the house of the LORD, after the ark had rest.
verses.6:17: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem; and they stood to their service according to their prescribed order.
verses.6:18: And these are those who stood in service, along with their sons: of the sons of the Kohathites, Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
verses.6:19: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.6:20: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.6:21: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.6:22: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.6:23: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand, was Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.6:25: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
verses.6:26: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.6:27: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.6:28: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.6:29: And their brethren, the sons of Merari, were on the left: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.6:30: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.6:31: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
verses.6:32: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.6:33: And their brethren the Levites were assigned to all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.6:34: But Aaron and his sons made offerings upon the altar of burnt offering and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God commanded.
verses.6:35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.6:37: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.6:38: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
verses.6:39: Now these are their dwelling places according to their settlements within their borders, belonging to the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites, for theirs was the lot.
verses.6:40: They gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasturelands surrounding it.
verses.6:41: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.6:42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah with its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,
verses.6:43: Hilez with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,
verses.6:44: Ashan with its pasturelands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasturelands;
verses.6:45: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its pasturelands, Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anathoth with its pasturelands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.6:46: And to the remaining sons of Kohath were given by lot ten cities from the family of the tribe, from the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh.
verses.6:47: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, were given thirteen cities from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.6:48: To the sons of Merari, according to their families, were given by lot twelve cities from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.6:49: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasturelands.
verses.6:50: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the children of Judah, from the tribe of the children of Simeon, and from the tribe of the children of Benjamin these cities which are called by name.
verses.6:51: Now some of the families of the sons of Kohath had the cities of their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.6:52: And they gave them the cities of refuge: Shechem with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasturelands,
verses.6:53: Jokmeam with its pasturelands, Beth Horon with its pasturelands,
verses.6:54: Aijalon with its pasturelands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasturelands.
verses.6:55: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its pasturelands, and Bileam with its pasturelands, for the family of the remaining sons of Kohath.
verses.6:56: To the sons of Gershom were given, from the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands, and Ashtaroth with its pasturelands;
verses.6:57: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands, Daberath with its pasturelands,
verses.6:58: Ramoth with its pasturelands, and Anem with its pasturelands;
verses.6:59: and from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its pasturelands, Abdon with its pasturelands,
verses.6:60: Hukok with its pasturelands, and Rehob with its pasturelands;
verses.6:61: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, Hammon with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.
verses.6:62: To the remaining sons of Merari were given, from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono with its pasturelands, and Tabor with its pasturelands;
verses.6:63: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands,
verses.6:64: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands;
verses.6:65: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, Mahanaim with its pasturelands,
verses.6:66: Heshbon with its pasturelands, and Jazer with its pasturelands.
verses.7:1: Now the sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
verses.7:2: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses—of Tola—mighty men of valor according to their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.7:3: The son of Uzzi was Izrahiah, and the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah—five, all of them chiefs.
verses.7:4: And with them, according to their generations by their fathers' houses, were bands of troops for war, thirty-six thousand, for they had many wives and sons.
verses.7:5: Now their brethren among all the families of Issachar were mighty men of valor, eighty-seven thousand enrolled by genealogy in all.
verses.7:6: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael—three in all.
verses.7:7: The sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri—five in all, heads of fathers' houses, mighty men of valor; and those enrolled by genealogy were twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
verses.7:8: The sons of Becher were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were the sons of Becher.
verses.7:9: And their enrollment by genealogy according to their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valor, was twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.7:10: The son of Jediael was Bilhan, and the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.7:11: All these were the sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers' houses, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred going out to war with the army.
verses.7:12: Also Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir, and Hushim was the son of Aher.
verses.7:13: The sons of Naphtali were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.7:14: The sons of Manasseh were Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she bore Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.7:15: And Machir took a wife for Huppim and Shuppim; the name of his sister was Maacah. And the name of the second was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.7:16: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; the name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.7:17: The son of Ulam was Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.7:18: And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.7:19: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.7:20: Now the sons of Ephraim were Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.7:21: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. Now the men of Gath who were born in the land slew them, because they came down to take away their livestock.
verses.7:22: Then Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, because calamity had come upon his house.
verses.7:24: Now his daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth Horon, as well as Uzzen Sheerah.
verses.7:25: And Rephah was his son, along with Resheph, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.7:26: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.7:27: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
verses.7:28: Now their possessions and dwellings were Bethel and its villages, to the east Naaran, to the west Gezer and its villages, also Shechem and its villages, as far as Ayyah and its villages;
verses.7:29: and along the borders of the sons of Manasseh were Beth Shean and its villages, Taanach and its villages, Megiddo and its villages, and Dor and its villages. In these dwelt the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel.
verses.7:30: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.7:31: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.7:32: And Heber fathered Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.7:33: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were the sons of Japhlet.
verses.7:34: The sons of Shemer were Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.7:35: And the sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.7:36: The sons of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.7:37: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
verses.7:38: The sons of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.
verses.7:39: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.7:40: All these were the sons of Asher, heads of their fathers' houses, choice men, mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. And their number enrolled by genealogy for military service in war was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.8:1: Now Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
verses.8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.8:3: And Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
verses.8:6: Now these were the sons of Ehud—they were the heads of fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them into exile to Manahath:
verses.8:7: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera—it was he who carried them into exile—and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.8:8: And Shaharaim fathered children in the country of Moab after he had sent them away—Hushim and Baara, his wives.
verses.8:9: By Hodesh his wife he fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
verses.8:10: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers' houses.
verses.8:11: And by Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.8:12: The sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod with its surrounding towns.
verses.8:13: And Beriah and Shema—they were the heads of the fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath.
verses.8:16: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
verses.8:18: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
verses.8:21: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
verses.8:25: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
verses.8:27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
verses.8:28: These were heads of fathers' houses according to their generations, chief men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.8:29: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
verses.8:30: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
verses.8:32: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. They also dwelt opposite their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.8:33: Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.8:34: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.8:35: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.8:36: And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.8:37: Moza fathered Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.8:38: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.8:39: And the sons of Eshek his brother were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.8:40: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, having many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.9:1: So all Israel was enrolled by genealogies, and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel; and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their unfaithfulness.
verses.9:2: Now the first inhabitants who were in their possession in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
verses.9:3: And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the sons of Judah, and some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.9:4: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Perez the son of Judah.
verses.9:5: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.9:6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.9:7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
verses.9:8: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham; and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.9:9: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers' houses according to the house of their fathers.
verses.9:10: And of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
verses.9:11: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.9:12: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.9:13: and their brethren, heads of their fathers' house, one thousand seven hundred and sixty—men of great ability for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.9:14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.9:15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.9:16: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.9:17: And the gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brethren; Shallum was the chief.
verses.9:18: Until this time they were at the king's gate toward the east; they were the gatekeepers for the camps of the sons of Levi.
verses.9:19: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren of his father's house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent; and their fathers had been over the camp of the LORD, keepers of the entrance.
verses.9:20: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in former times; the LORD was with him.
verses.9:21: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.9:22: All those chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. They were enrolled by their genealogies in their villages; David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their office of trust.
verses.9:23: So they and their sons were over the gates of the house of the LORD—the house of the tent—by watches.
verses.9:24: On the four sides were the gatekeepers: toward the east, the west, the north, and the south.
verses.9:25: And their brethren in their villages were to come for seven days from time to time to be with them.
verses.9:26: For the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.9:27: And they lodged all around the house of God, because the watch was upon them, and they had charge of the key to open it morning by morning.
verses.9:28: And some of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for they brought them in by count and took them out by count.
verses.9:29: Some of them also were appointed over the furnishings and over all the sacred vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests compounded the ointment of the spices.
verses.9:31: And Mattithiah of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the trusted charge over the things baked in flat pans.
verses.9:32: And some of their brethren of the sons of the Kohathites were in charge of the showbread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
verses.9:33: Now these are the singers, heads of fathers' houses of the Levites, dwelling in the chambers, free from other duties; for day and night they were engaged in their work.
verses.9:34: These were the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites, chief men according to their generations; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.9:35: Now in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah.
verses.9:36: And his firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.9:38: And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. They also dwelt opposite their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.
verses.9:39: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.9:40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-Baal, and Merib-Baal fathered Micah.
verses.9:41: And the sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, and Tahrea.
verses.9:42: And Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.9:43: And Moza fathered Binea, and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
verses.9:44: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.10:1: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:2: And the Philistines closely pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines slew Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.10:3: And the battle grew fierce against Saul, and the archers overtook him, and he was wounded by the archers.
verses.10:4: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised men come and abuse me." But his armor-bearer would not, for he was greatly afraid. So Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
verses.10:5: And when his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell upon the sword and died.
verses.10:6: Thus Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.10:7: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.10:8: And it came to pass on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:9: And they stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent word throughout the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the tidings to their idols and to the people.
verses.10:10: And they placed his armor in the temple of their gods, and fastened his skull in the temple of Dagon.
verses.10:11: And all Jabesh Gilead heard of all that the Philistines had done to Saul.
verses.10:12: Then all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh; and they buried their bones under the terebinth tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.10:13: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness which he had committed against the LORD, because of the word of the LORD which he did not keep, and also because he consulted a medium for guidance.
verses.10:14: But he did not inquire of the LORD; therefore He put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
verses.11:1: Then all Israel gathered together to David at Hebron, saying, "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.11:2: Also in time past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them in; and the LORD your God said to you, 'You shall shepherd My people Israel, and you shall be ruler over My people Israel.'"
verses.11:3: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Samuel.
verses.11:4: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, and there were the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.11:5: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You shall not enter here." Nevertheless David captured the stronghold of Zion, which is the City of David.
verses.11:6: Now David said, "Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall become chief and commander." So Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and became chief.
verses.11:7: Then David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the City of David.
verses.11:8: And he built up the city all around, from the Millo even to the surrounding area; and Joab restored the rest of the city.
verses.11:9: So David went on and became continually greater, and the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.11:10: Now these are the chiefs of the mighty men whom David had, who strongly supported him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.11:11: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, chief of the captains; he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain at one time.
verses.11:12: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was among the three mighty men.
verses.11:13: He was with David at Pas Dammim, where the Philistines were gathered together for battle; and there was a plot of ground full of barley, and the people fled before the Philistines.
verses.11:14: But they took their stand in the midst of the plot and defended it, and struck down the Philistines; and the LORD brought about a great deliverance.
verses.11:15: Now three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the camp of the Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.11:16: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then at Bethlehem.
verses.11:17: And David longed and said, "Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!"
verses.11:18: So the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate, and carried it and brought it to David. Yet David would not drink it, but poured it out to the LORD.
verses.11:19: And he said, "Far be it from me, before my God, to do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who went at the peril of their lives? For at the peril of their lives they brought it." Therefore he refused to drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
verses.11:20: Now Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain, and he had a name among the three.
verses.11:21: Of the three he was more honored than the two, and he became their commander; yet he did not attain to the three.
verses.11:22: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, great in exploits, struck down the two lionlike heroes of Moab; he also went down and slew a lion in the midst of a pit on a snowy day.
verses.11:23: And he struck down an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits tall. In the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.11:24: These things Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.11:25: Behold, he was more honored than the thirty, yet he did not attain to the three; and David appointed him over his bodyguard.
verses.11:26: Also the mighty men of the armies were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.11:27: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.11:28: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.11:29: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.11:30: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.11:31: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.11:32: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.11:33: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.11:34: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.11:35: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.11:36: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.11:37: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.11:38: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.11:39: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.11:40: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.11:41: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.11:42: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.11:43: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.11:45: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.11:46: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.11:47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.12:1: Now these are the ones who came to David at Ziklag while he was still restricted because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, helpers in warfare,
verses.12:2: armed with bows, using both the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows from the bow, of the brethren of Saul from Benjamin:
verses.12:3: the chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite;
verses.12:4: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and over the thirty;
verses.12:5: Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
verses.12:6: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.12:7: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.12:8: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.12:9: From the Gadites some separated themselves to David at the stronghold in the wilderness—mighty men of valor, men of the host for warfare, skilled with shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and who were swift as gazelles upon the mountains:
verses.12:10: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.12:11: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.12:12: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.12:13: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.12:14: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.12:15: These were of the sons of Gad, commanders of the host; the least was equal to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.
verses.12:16: These are the ones who crossed over the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks; and they put to flight all those of the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
verses.12:17: Then some of the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
verses.12:18: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, "If you have come in peace to me to help me, my heart shall be united with you; but if to betray me to my adversaries, seeing there is no violence in my hands, may the God of our fathers look upon it and rebuke you."
verses.12:19: Then the Spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the captains: "We are yours, O David, and with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers; for your God has helped you." So David received them and made them captains of the troop.
verses.12:20: Some from Manasseh also defected to David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle; yet they did not help them, for after taking counsel the lords of the Philistines sent him away, saying, "At the cost of our heads he will defect to his master Saul."
verses.12:21: As he went to Ziklag, there defected to him from Manasseh: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, heads of the thousands who belonged to Manasseh.
verses.12:22: And they helped David against the raiding band, for they were all mighty men of valor, and they became commanders in the army.
verses.12:23: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.12:24: Now these are the numbers of the divisions armed for war who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the word of the LORD:
verses.12:25: of the sons of Judah bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred armed for war;
verses.12:26: of the sons of Simeon, mighty men of valor for war, seven thousand one hundred;
verses.12:27: of the sons of Levi, four thousand six hundred;
verses.12:28: and Jehoiada, the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand seven hundred;
verses.12:29: and Zadok, a young man, mighty of valor, and from his father's house twenty-two captains;
verses.12:30: of the sons of Benjamin, the brethren of Saul, three thousand—for until then the majority of them had kept allegiance to the house of Saul;
verses.12:31: of the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, men of renown in their fathers' houses;
verses.12:32: of the half-tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king;
verses.12:33: of the sons of Issachar, men who possessed understanding of the times, to know what Israel should do—their chiefs were two hundred, and all their brethren were at their command;
verses.12:34: of Zebulun, those going forth to the army, setting battle in array with all manner of weapons of war, fifty thousand, keeping rank with no double heart;
verses.12:35: of Naphtali, one thousand captains, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear;
verses.12:36: of the Danites, who could set battle in array, twenty-eight thousand six hundred;
verses.12:37: of Asher, those going forth to the army to draw up battle array, forty thousand;
verses.12:38: and from across the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of weapons of war for battle, one hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.12:39: All these men of war, who could keep battle rank, came to Hebron with a whole heart to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were also of one heart to make David king.
verses.12:40: And they were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their brethren had made provision for them.
verses.12:41: Moreover those who were near to them, even as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys and on camels, on mules and on oxen—provisions of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine and oil, and oxen and sheep in abundance, for there was joy in Israel.
verses.13:1: Then David took counsel with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.13:2: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you, and if it is from the LORD our God, let us send out far and wide to our brethren who remain in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and the Levites in the cities of their pasturelands, that they may gather together to us;
verses.13:3: and let us bring back the ark of our God to us, for we did not inquire at it in the days of Saul."
verses.13:4: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for the matter was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.13:5: So David assembled all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt to the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.13:6: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who sits enthroned above the cherubim, which is called by the Name.
verses.13:7: So they carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart.
verses.13:8: And David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs, with lyres, with harps, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.13:9: And when they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza stretched out his hand to take hold of the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.13:10: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Uzza, and He struck him because he had put out his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.13:11: And David became angry because the LORD had broken out with an outburst against Uzza; and he called that place Perez-uzza, as it is to this day.
verses.13:12: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, "How shall I bring the ark of God to me?"
verses.13:13: So David did not move the ark to himself into the City of David, but turned it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.13:14: And the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belonged to him.
verses.14:1: Now Huram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar timber, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.
verses.14:2: And David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.14:3: And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.
verses.14:4: And these are the names of the children who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.14:8: Now when the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David; and David heard of it and went out against them.
verses.14:9: And the Philistines came and made a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.14:10: Then David inquired of God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines, and will You deliver them into my hand?" And the LORD said to him, "Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand."
verses.14:11: So they went up to Baal-perazim, and David struck them down there. Then David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of waters." Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.14:12: And they abandoned their gods there, so David gave the command, and they were burned with fire.
verses.14:13: Then the Philistines once again made a raid in the valley.
verses.14:14: Therefore David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "Do not go up after them; circle around behind them, and come upon them opposite the balsam trees.
verses.14:15: And it shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then you shall go out to battle, for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines."
verses.14:16: So David did just as God commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
verses.14:17: And the fame of David went out into all the lands, and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all the nations.
verses.15:1: And David made houses for himself in the City of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.15:2: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God except the Levites, for the LORD has chosen them to bear the ark of the LORD and to minister to Him forever."
verses.15:3: Then David assembled all Israel to Jerusalem, in order to bring up the ark of the LORD to its own place which he had prepared for it.
verses.15:4: Then David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.15:5: of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the leader, and his brethren, one hundred and twenty;
verses.15:6: of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the leader, and his brethren, two hundred and twenty;
verses.15:7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brethren;
verses.15:8: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his brethren;
verses.15:9: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his brethren;
verses.15:10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brethren.
verses.15:11: And David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites—Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
verses.15:12: He said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, both you and your brethren, so that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place I have prepared for it.
verses.15:13: For because it was not you the first time, the LORD our God broke out against us, since we did not seek Him according to the prescribed ordinance."
verses.15:14: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.15:15: And the sons of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders, with the poles upon them, just as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.15:16: Then David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brethren as singers with instruments of music—harps, lyres, and cymbals—sounding aloud to lift up voices of joy.
verses.15:17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.15:18: and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
verses.15:19: The singers—Heman, Asaph, and Ethan—were appointed to sound aloud with bronze cymbals;
verses.15:20: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah with harps according to Alamoth;
verses.15:21: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah with lyres according to the Sheminith, to lead the music.
verses.15:22: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites, was over the music; he directed the music, for he was skillful.
verses.15:23: And Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.15:24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.15:25: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.15:26: And it came to pass, because God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.15:27: Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the music leader with the singers; and David also wore a linen ephod.
verses.15:28: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets and with cymbals, making resounding music with harps and lyres.
verses.15:29: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.16:1: So they brought the ark of God and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.16:2: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.16:3: Then he distributed to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to each person a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.16:4: And he appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to commemorate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD God of Israel:
verses.16:5: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah; then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel with harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded aloud with the cymbals;
verses.16:6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.16:7: On that day David first appointed this thanksgiving to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brethren:
verses.16:8: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the peoples.
verses.16:9: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wondrous works.
verses.16:10: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
verses.16:11: Seek the LORD and His strength; continually seek His face.
verses.16:12: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.16:13: O seed of Israel His servant, you sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.16:14: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are throughout all the earth.
verses.16:15: Remember His covenant forever, the word which He commanded for a thousand generations—
verses.16:16: the covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac,
verses.16:17: which He confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.16:18: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the allotted portion of your inheritance,"
verses.16:19: when you were few in number—very few indeed, and sojourners in it.
verses.16:20: When they wandered from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people,
verses.16:21: He permitted no one to oppress them; indeed, He rebuked kings for their sake:
verses.16:22: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and do My prophets no harm."
verses.16:23: Sing to the LORD, all the earth; proclaim the good tidings of His salvation from day to day.
verses.16:25: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is also to be feared above all gods.
verses.16:26: For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.16:27: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and gladness are in His place.
verses.16:28: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
verses.16:29: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and come before Him. Worship the LORD in the splendor of holiness.
verses.16:30: Tremble before Him, all the earth; indeed, the world is firmly established, it shall not be moved.
verses.16:31: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; and let them say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!"
verses.16:32: Let the sea roar, and all its fullness; let the field exult, and all that is in it.
verses.16:33: Then the trees of the forest shall sing for joy before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth.
verses.16:34: Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; for His lovingkindness endures forever.
verses.16:35: And say, "Save us, O God of our salvation; gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name, and to glory in Your praise."
verses.16:36: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said, "Amen!" and praised the LORD.
verses.16:37: So he left Asaph and his brethren there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required;
verses.16:38: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight brethren, including Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah, to be gatekeepers;
verses.16:39: and he left Zadok the priest and his brethren the priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.16:40: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the Law of the LORD which He commanded Israel;
verses.16:41: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of the chosen men who were designated by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because His lovingkindness endures forever;
verses.16:42: and with them Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals for those who should sound aloud, and instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.
verses.16:43: Then all the people departed, every man to his house; and David returned to bless his own household.
verses.17:1: Now it came to pass, when David dwelt in his house, that David spoke to Nathan the prophet, "Behold, I dwell in a house of cedars, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under curtains."
verses.17:2: And Nathan said to David, "Do all that is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.17:3: And it came to pass that same night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.17:4: "Go and speak to My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD: It is not you who shall build Me the house to dwell in.
verses.17:5: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day that I brought Israel up to this day, but I have been from tent to tent, and from tabernacle to tabernacle.
verses.17:6: In all the places where I have walked among all Israel, have I ever spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, "Why have you not built Me a house of cedars?"'
verses.17:7: Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler over My people Israel.
verses.17:8: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you; and I will make for you a name like the name of the great men who are on the earth.
verses.17:9: Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be disturbed no more; nor shall the sons of iniquity wear them out anymore, as at the first,
verses.17:10: and from the days that I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I declare to you that the LORD will build you a house.
verses.17:11: And it shall come to pass, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be of your sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.17:12: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.17:13: I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to Me a son; and My lovingkindness I will not take away from him, as I took it away from him who was before you.
verses.17:14: And I will confirm him in My house and in My kingdom forever; and his throne shall be established forever.'"
verses.17:15: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.17:16: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, "Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me thus far?
verses.17:17: And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O God; for You have also spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
verses.17:18: What more can David say to You concerning the honor bestowed upon Your servant? For You know Your servant.
verses.17:19: O LORD, for Your servant's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.17:20: O LORD, there is none like You, nor is there any God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.17:21: And who is like Your people Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people—to make for Yourself a name of great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?
verses.17:22: For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, O LORD, have become their God.
verses.17:23: And now, O LORD, let the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be established forever, and do as You have spoken.
verses.17:24: So let it be established, and let Your name be magnified forever, saying, 'The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, is God to Israel.' And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.
verses.17:25: For You, O my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house; therefore Your servant has found courage to pray before You.
verses.17:26: And now, O LORD, You are God, and You have spoken this goodness concerning Your servant.
verses.17:27: Now therefore You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You have blessed it, O LORD, and it shall be blessed forever."
verses.18:1: Now after this it came to pass that David struck the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.18:2: Then he struck Moab, and the Moabites became David's servants, bringing tribute.
verses.18:3: And David struck Hadadezer king of Zobah as far as Hamath, as he went to establish his power by the River Euphrates.
verses.18:4: David captured from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also David hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.18:5: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
verses.18:6: Then David stationed garrisons in Syria of Damascus, and the Syrians became David's servants, bringing tribute. And the LORD preserved David wherever he went.
verses.18:7: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.18:8: Also from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a very great quantity of bronze; with it Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.
verses.18:9: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.18:10: he sent Hadoram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him—for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou—and with him he sent all kinds of vessels of gold, silver, and bronze.
verses.18:11: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold that he had brought from all the nations—from Edom, from Moab, from the sons of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.18:12: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
verses.18:13: He also placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the LORD preserved David wherever he went.
verses.18:14: So David reigned over all Israel, and administered judgment and righteousness to all his people.
verses.18:15: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.18:16: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were the priests; Shavsha was scribe;
verses.18:17: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials at the king's side.
verses.19:1: Now it came to pass after this that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.19:2: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came to Hanun in the land of the sons of Ammon to comfort him.
verses.19:3: And the princes of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?"
verses.19:4: Therefore Hanun took David's servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, at their hips, and sent them away.
verses.19:5: Then certain men went and told David about the men. And he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly humiliated. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return."
verses.19:6: When the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syrian Maacah, and from Zobah.
verses.19:7: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, along with the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. Also the sons of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.19:8: Now when David heard of it, he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.19:9: Then the sons of Ammon came out and drew up in battle array at the entrance of the city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
verses.19:10: When Joab saw that the battle line was set against him both in front and behind, he chose from all the choice men of Israel, and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
verses.19:11: And the rest of the people he placed under the command of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in battle array against the sons of Ammon.
verses.19:12: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall come to my rescue; but if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.
verses.19:13: Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the LORD do what is good in His sight."
verses.19:14: So Joab and the people who were with him drew near before the Syrians for the battle, and they fled before him.
verses.19:15: When the sons of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. Then Joab went to Jerusalem.
verses.19:16: Now when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated before Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.
verses.19:17: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan, came upon them, and set up in array against them. So when David had set up in battle array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.19:18: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he put Shophach the commander of the army to death.
verses.19:19: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated before Israel, they made peace with David and served him. So the Syrians were not willing to help the sons of Ammon anymore.
verses.20:1: Now it came about at the turn of the year, at the time when kings go forth, that Joab led out the force of the army and ravaged the land of the sons of Ammon; and he came and laid siege to Rabbah, while David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab struck Rabbah and tore it down.
verses.20:2: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found its weight to be a talent of gold, and precious stones were in it; and it was set upon the head of David. He also brought forth the spoil of the city in exceedingly great abundance.
verses.20:3: And he brought out the people who were in it, and cut them with the saw, and with iron picks, and with saws; and thus David did to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
